title: Tab integration and AisleCatalog wiring
description: Replace the existing empty-state placeholder in `CookbookApp/Tabs/ShoppingListsTab.swift` with `ShoppingListsView`. In `CookbookApp/CookbookAppApp.swift` (or the root scene composer), instantiate `AisleCatalog` once when the configured folder URL becomes available; call `catalog.load(from:)` when the folder is first opened and whenever the user changes folders; inject the catalog into the environment via `.environment` or `.environmentObject` so all shopping-list views can access it. Run `xcodegen generate` from the repo root after all new source files have been added.
acceptance_criteria: `ShoppingListsTab.swift` renders `ShoppingListsView` instead of the empty-state placeholder
`AisleCatalog` is instantiated once at the root scene level
Folder open and folder-change events trigger `catalog.load(from:)`
`AisleCatalog` is accessible in `ShoppingListsView` and `ShoppingListDetailView` via the SwiftUI environment
App compiles and runs in the simulator without errors
